chapters.title: About This Blueprint
chapters.tex:
This AI-authored blueprint is assembled from the references in \texttt{refs.bib}
and the source-faithful formalization record.  The main text keeps the
nontrivial mathematical route and its proofs; standard definitions and
mechanical transport are omitted.  The complete intermediary record is
preserved in \texttt{content-formalization.tex}.  A mathematical node is an
interface for the formalization: one node may be implemented by several Lean
declarations.  Printed source numbers use \texttt{\textbackslash dcref},
citations use BibTeX keys, and internal dependencies use
\texttt{\textbackslash ref}.
